title: 第9章 上门羞辱第10章 灭杀小翠
content_zh:
走入的秦琪一脸冷漠的扫视婉妃跟江若尘，态度孤傲，高高在上。
好似她本身是九天上的仙人，在睥睨蝼蚁！
“江若尘，现在的你肯定很疑惑，王后娘娘为什么突然改变了主意吧？”
秦琪冰冷的目光最后定格在江若尘的身上。
“难不成跟你有关？”
江若尘道。
“没错，就是我进言让王后娘娘留下了你，让你参加岁末大比！”
秦琪道。
江若尘一眼就看出了秦琪来者不善，绝不会是出于好心。
而秦琪接下来的话，确实印证了他的猜测！
“但你不要自作多情，我让王后娘娘留下你，并不是帮你，只是想亲手洗刷你给我带来的耻辱！
我要向整个镇南王朝的人证明，你江若尘，配不上我秦琪！”
秦琪眼神怨毒，似乎恨不得江若尘立刻死去！
江若尘冷笑，心中鄙夷秦琪的同时，对原身的付出，更加感到不值：“我明白了，你要在岁末大比上轻松击败我，让我彻底跌入尘埃，卑微如狗，从而向所有人证明，你秦琪是天之骄女，而我江若尘是个废物，从今以后彻底划清界限。”
“没错，这也是王后的意思，距离岁末大比还有一个月的时间，我希望你好好准备，毕竟这是你唯一的机会。”
秦琪道。
江若尘再次冷笑：“好一个划清界限，你秦琪凭什么这么确定，我会一直纠缠你呢？”
“还需要凭什么吗？你这废物不历来如此？”
“好好准备吧，这是你唯一的机会，岁末大比一过，你我彻底将会是两个世界的人！”
秦琪一脸睥睨，以上位者的姿态说完这些话后，转身便要离去，她来此似乎只是通知。

“慢着！”
走到门口的时候，江若尘大声叫住！
秦琪停住，却未回头。
“秦琪，你确实小有天赋，心思也很恶毒，但我想说的是，岁末大比胜负未定！”
江若尘怒声道。
秦琪噗嗤一笑，似乎听到了多么好笑的笑话。
“呵呵，胜负未定？好，我拭目以待。”
说完，秦琪头也不回的走了。
“秦琪，王后……好恶毒的算计！”
明白了留下意图的婉妃情绪十分复杂。
既愤怒，也为江若尘心痛，担忧……
content_en:
Qin Qi walked in and glanced at Concubine Wan and Jiang Ruochen with an indifferent expression, her attitude was aloof and aloof.
It was as if she was an immortal in the heavens, looking down upon the ants!
"Jiang Ruochen, you must be wondering now why the Queen suddenly changed her mind, right?"
Qin Qi's cold gaze finally fixed on Jiang Ruochen.
"Could it have something to do with you?"
Jiang Ruochen said.
"That's right, I was the one who asked the Queen to keep you and let you participate in the year-end competition!"
Qin Qi said.
Jiang Ruochen could tell at a glance that Qin Qi came here with bad intentions and was definitely not out of good intentions.
And Qin Qi's next words indeed confirmed his guess!
"But don't be sentimental. I asked the Queen to keep you, not to help you, but to personally wash away the shame you have brought to me!
I want to prove to the entire Zhennan Dynasty that you, Jiang Ruochen, are not worthy of me, Qin Qi! "
Qin Qi's eyes were filled with hatred, as if she wanted Jiang Ruochen to die immediately!
Jiang Ruochen sneered. While he despised Qin Qi in his heart, he felt even more unworthy of his original efforts: "I understand. You want to easily defeat me in the year-end competition and make me fall into the dust completely, humble as a dog. This will prove to everyone that you, Qin Qi, are the proud daughter of heaven, and I, Jiang Ruochen, am a waste. From now on, we will completely draw a clear line."
"Yes, this is what the queen means. There is still one month left before the year-end competition. I hope you will prepare well. After all, this is your only chance."
Qin Qi said.
Jiang Ruochen sneered again: "What a clear boundary. Why are you, Qin Qi, so sure that I will keep pestering you?"
"What else do you need? Aren't you a loser like this all the time?"
"Get ready, this is your only chance. After the year-end competition, you and I will be completely different from each other!"
Qin Qi looked stern, and after saying these words in a superior manner, she turned around and left. She seemed to be here just to give a notice.
"Wait!"
When he reached the door, Jiang Ruochen shouted to stop!
Qin Qi stopped but did not look back.
"Qin Qi, you are indeed very talented and very vicious, but what I want to say is that the outcome of the year-end competition is still uncertain!"
Jiang Ruochen said angrily.
Qin Qi chuckled, as if she had heard what a funny joke.
"Haha, the outcome is still uncertain? Okay, I'll wait and see."
After saying that, Qin Qi left without looking back.
"Qin Qi, the queen...what a vicious plan!"
Concubine Wan, who understood her intention to stay, had very complicated emotions.
Not only angry, but also heartbroken and worried for Jiang Ruochen...
